description: arXiv:2507.01693v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Recent work shows that distinct inputs produce distinct hidden representations in LLMs, so the input can in principle be recovered from them. Yet, no existing method can reliably do so from the model's output text or logits alone.
